name: Coupon Countdown for WooCommerce
author: HealoMax

sections.description:
Coupon Countdown for WooCommerce revolutionizes the coupon redemption process with its innovative 1-click coupon application system, combined with an urgency-creating countdown timer. This powerful combination helps eliminate common friction points in the checkout process, leading to higher conversion rates and increased sales.

Core Features

Revolutionary 1-Click Coupon Application
Instant coupon application with a single click
Automatic product addition to cart
Direct checkout redirection
No copy-pasting required
Zero chance of coupon code typos
Streamlined purchase journey

Coupon Management
Assign a specific coupon code to a selected product.
Add an optional custom image to enhance visibility
Specify expiration date and time

Display Customization
Customize coupon code label
Customize countdown timer label
Customize apply button label

Product Integration
Easy submission of product ID
Seamless WooCommerce integration

Pro Features

All Core Features +
Dual coupon options
Add UNLIMITED Products
Enable/disable countdown timer
Enable/disable one-click apply button
Display coupon on multiple product pages
Assign a specific coupon code to selected products

Key Benefits

Streamlined Purchase Process:
Eliminates the need to copy and paste coupon codes
Reduces cart abandonment due to coupon errors
Saves customers valuable time during checkout
Creates a frustration-free shopping experience

Increased Conversion Rates:
Removes friction from the purchase process
Creates urgency with countdown timer
Reduces decision-making time

Enhanced User Experience:
One-click journey from product to checkout page
Clear visibility of savings
Seamless integration with WooCommerce

Configuration

Coupon Management:

Go to WordPress dashboard
=> Coupon Countdown.
=> Enter the coupon code in the field.
=> Select an image, if you don’t want leave it blank.
=> Set a date and time in the expiration field.

     The countdown will display the remaining time automatically.

Save Changes

Demo

Check out the Coupon Countdown demo of this plugin at: Redirect Pro for WooCommerce

Support

For support or assistance, at the forum.

Notes

  • This plugin has been tested with WooCommerce 5.0 and above. Compatibility with older versions of WooCommerce is not guaranteed.

  • Thank you for using the Coupon Countdown for WooCommerce Plugin!

  • We hope it enhances your WooCommerce store’s functionality.

Credits

  • Author: HealoMax
  • Website: Mastering Sales Mastery
sections.installation:
1. Upload the coupon-countdown-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ dashboard in your WordPress.
sections.faq:
Q: How do I assign a coupon to a specific product?
A: In the Coupon Countdown for WooCommerce settings, add a product ID in the labeled field for Product ID. You can customize the coupon text, add an image, and set the expiration date and time.

Q: What if I want to change the coupon code ?
A: You can change the coupon code text from the settings page.

Q: Can customers still manually enter coupon codes? =
A: Yes, customers can still use the standard WooCommerce coupon field if they prefer, but the one-click option provides a much smoother experience.

Q: How does creating urgency help increase sales?
A: Creating urgency encourages customers to make quicker purchasing decisions by instilling a fear of missing out (FOMO). When customers see a countdown timer or limited-time offers, they feel compelled to act fast to secure the deal before it expires. This psychological trigger can lead to increased conversion rates, as customers are more likely to complete their purchases rather than risk losing out on a valuable opportunity. Additionally, urgency can enhance the perceived value of a product or service, making it more appealing to potential buyers.
